en: The Hymn of One Hundred and Eight Names of Avalokiteśvara.
Om, homage to Avalokiteśvara!
O Padmasattva, Great Lotus, Lord of the World, Great Lord!
O Avalokiteśvara, foremost among the steadfast, Vajradharma, homage be to you! || 1 ||
O Dharmarāja, Greatly Pure One, King of Beings, O Great-minded One! O Lotus-natured One, Great Lotus, Lord of the Lotus—homage be to you! || 2 ||
O Lotus-born One, O You who possess the luster of a beautiful lotus, O Pure Lotus, O Excellent Purifier!
O Vajra-lotus, O You marked with the beautiful lotus, O Lotus-lotus, homage be to You! || 3 ||
O Great Universe, O Great World, O Great Body, O Great Simile;
O Great Steadfast One, O Great Hero, O Great Śauri—salutations be unto you! || 4 ||
O you who possess the intention of sentient beings, the Great Vehicle, and the Great Yoga; O Grandfather, Śambhu, Śaṅkara, the one whose purpose is purity, the Buddha Padma—homage be to you! (5)
O you who have realized the true meaning of the nature of phenomena, the True Dharma, the Pure Dharma, and the Excellent Dharma;
O Great Dharma, Supreme among the Virtuous Dharmas, the Wheel of Dharma—homage be to you!
O Buddha-being, supreme among true beings, being of the Dharma, upholder of true beings;
best of beings, knower of true beings, O Being of Beings, homage be to you! (7)
O Avalokiteśvara, supreme protector, great lord who beholds all;
O light of lights, for the sake of the world, lord of the world—homage be to you! (8)
O you who are the world, the syllable, the non-syllable, the great, the foremost of the supreme syllables,
the syllable among non-syllables, the all-seeing one, the imperishable wheel— homage be to you!
O Lotus-handed One, O Great-handed One, O Consoler, O Giver!
O Buddha-Dharma, O Great Buddha, O You whose very nature is the Buddha—homage be to you! 10.
O Buddha-form, great form, vajra-form, most beautiful one! O supreme light of the Dharma, foremost in brilliance, illuminator of the world—homage be to you! (11)
O Padmaśrīnātha, foremost of lords, O Dharmaśrīnātha, possessor of lords;
O Brahmanātha, Great Brahmā, Son of Brahmā, homage be to you! (12)
O Lamp, foremost of lamps, fierce lamp, light of the lamp, excellent illuminator;
O Lord of the lamp, great lamp, lamp of the Buddhas—homage be to you!
O one consecrated by the Buddhas, O foremost of Buddhas, O son of the Buddha, O great wise one!
O you whose head is the supreme consecration of the Buddhas, O Buddha of Buddhas, homage be to you! 14.
O Buddha-eye, Great Eye, Dharma-eye, Great Seer;
O you whose entire essence is meditative concentration and gnosis, Vajra-eyed one, homage be to you! 15.
Thus, by meditating upon or even praising these one hundred and eight secondary names of yours with one's whole being, one shall attain sovereignty over the world.
The hymn of supplication in one hundred and eight names of the noble Avalokiteśvara is complete.
